analysis.title: MINI PLENARY: EAT & NAME THE ORGANELLES!
analysis.description: A plenary activity slide featuring a dark background with a glowing cybernetic/neon border framing a top-centered title, an instructional prompt to examine a jelly cell model and identify sweet-represented organelles, and a large central 3D illustration of a translucent dome-shaped jelly cell model containing rainbow sprinkles and a multi-layered jawbreaker candy core on a clear dish.
analysis.layout: Centred vertical layout with the slide title at top center, instruction text directly beneath it, and a large central 3D rendering of the jelly cell model occupying the lower two-thirds of the framed canvas.
